description: Proposed shopfront alterations and installation of kitchen extraction equipment and an air intake louvre to rear elevation.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

C0226(M)/M01 Rev. A; Location plan and site plan; Design and specification for kitchen ventilation system rev.A dated 10/06/2026 prepared by KRS Steel Services; Specifications document tilted 'Purified Air ON100 Odour Neutralizer Technical and Operation Manual' prepared by CK Direct; Drawing no.1; Drawing no.3; Drawing no.2; Drawing no.4; Noise Report ref. MDR/J6137a dated 18th April 2026 prepared by RandTech Consulting Ltd.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. The proposed external extraction equipment including ductwork and air intake louvre to rear elevation shall be painted in a colour tone to match the existing brickwork of the host building. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D3 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and policy CK2 of the Kilburn Neighbourhood Plan 2023-2033.
Condition : 4 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, or by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with all machinery operating together at maximum capacity.

Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 6 - The installation, operation, and maintenance of the odour abatement equipment and extract system, including the height of the extract duct and discharge outlet, shall be in accordance with the technical guidance set out in 'EMAQ+Control of Odour and Noise from Commercial Kitchen Exhaust Systems.  The extraction system shall be installed prior to the commencement of the use and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by cooking odour in accordance with the requirements of policy A1 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017
